documents.title: Natural Earth 1:50m admin-0 polygons — Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia
documents.publicationCitation: Natural Earth vector, ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson, pinned source commit ca96624a; vendored as public/data/territory/cultural/countries_50m.geojson.
documents.notes: Used only to cut the three Baltic republic polygons out of the already verified pre-recognition USSR exterior after the USSR State Council's 6 September 1991 recognition. The official Soviet resolutions establish timing/legal status; the modern public-domain polygons provide the spatial realization of the republic boundary segments. No other part of the USSR exterior is replaced by modern geometry.
